n: Autograph Edition 30 In. 4.2 Cu. Ft. Marino Dual Fuel Range With 4 Burner Gas Cooktop And Electric Convection Oven In Black Stainless Steel With Champagne Bronze Accents
desc: The ZLINE Autograph Edition 30 in. 4.2 cu. ft. Marino Dual Fuel Range with 4 Burner Gas Cooktop and Electric Convection Oven in Black Stainless Steel with Champagne Bronze Accents (MDRBZ-30-CB) combines the versatility of a gas cooktop with 4 Italian-made auto-reignition burners, an electric convection oven with digital thermostat technology, and an edge-to-edge Vista oven door window design. With intentional lines, sculpted hardware, and a distinctly modern presence, Marino embodies the artistry and engineering behind ZLINE’s attainable luxury mission.
hl: The ZLINE Marino Collection brings a new face to professional cooking with a distinct contemporary design profile
Customize your ZLINE Autograph Edition Dual Fuel Range with elegant Champagne Bronze knob and handle accents
Designed as both a visual anchor and a functional touchpoint, Marino’s signature handle utilizes bullnose geometry to balance comfort and durability
Savor the benefits of dual fuel cooking with a high-powered gas cooktop and an electric convection oven with high-grade heating elements
Precision-marked control knobs illuminate bright white and intensify as they turn, delivering clear visual feedback and an intuitive connection to cooking performance
4 Italian-made gas burners utilize automatic reignition innovation for improved temperature control and cooktop safety
spec: 30 in. W x 27.75 in. D x 36 in. H
(4) Brass Burners with Porcelain Cook Top with electronic spark ignition for all burners
Manual Clean - Convection Electric Oven - 4.2 cu. ft. deep oven
1 year parts and service, limited lifetime warranty on burners
